rules.rule: New functions must validate inputs at boundaries, prefer pure functions and explicit dependencies. Flag hardcoded secrets, missing error handling, and functions over 50 lines.
Shell scripts must quote paths with spaces, avoid rm -rf and git reset --hard without guards, prefer set -euo pipefail.
Skills must have valid frontmatter (name, description, argument-hint), When to Use, Workflow steps in order, Rules, Verification. Never invent CLI flags — verify via --help.
Flag hardcoded API keys, tokens, secrets in JSON configs. Suggest env vars instead.
